程序包 com.ta.recruitment.servlet

package com.ta.recruitment.servlet
Contains servlet classes for the TA Recruitment System.

This package provides REST-like API endpoints for data persistence and synchronization. The main components include:

  • StorageSyncServlet - Handles JSON file-based storage operations for recruitment data including user profiles, job postings, applications, and chat messages.

All servlets in this package follow REST principles and support CORS for cross-origin requests. Data is stored in JSON format in the WEB-INF/data/storage.json file.
